author: miaopantao
body:
KEo could open the assets plugin but was rejected before login because the built-in Buzz identity table did not include their personal key. Assets rc.5 binds that key to the existing original-site member `keo`, preserving the member's existing `admin` role and the existing community/session checks. It grants no factory role and changes no backend members or permissions.

The package preserves the rc.4 business code outside the role module, with a pinned baseline checksum and a reproducible build check. Old packages and the installed baseline targets remain unchanged; the existing aggregate packaging contract refreshes only embedded registry metadata.

Validation: full source CI at `9ec05b39297d32a847410bcccf51dd2fec382bd4` (194 Node, 69 Python); full live-directory CI at `a208e9b40ad1cef4cf2e068d15fcaca2e200c3eb` (199 Node, 69 Python); package/checksum checks; real original-site member/session readback; official Buzz 1.0.2 native discover at distribution commit `5bd608263860d8d9519faa9ce64ff9dea6c5c6e6`.

The standalone distribution and live directory are published. KEo's native approval, installation and device acceptance are still pending. Main is not merged. No host build or client upgrade was performed.
title: fix(assets): bind KEo to the existing assets member

author: miaopantao
body:
All 17 OPCB plugins now carry the selected 3dicons.co V1 color/dynamic identity inside their own update packages. Package PNGs, existing native navigation and launchers, catalog tiles and chat installation cards share the same original transparent image. Reviewing and updating each plugin also updates its icon; no separate icon plugin, runtime image request or additional permission is needed.

The current catalog contains 18 packages, retaining separate Higgsfield 1.3/1.4 business lines. Exact public business baselines are preserved, including Task Center rc.17, Company Board rc.14, factory/assets rc.3, HTML Reader rc.2 and Mobile Design rc.9 review-position, scrolling and annotation fixes. Plugin Center 0.3.3 retains its existing installation cards, contributors and GitHub request identification.

The center resolves `distribution/3dicons-catalog-20261115` in the same official repository before reading its registry at that exact head. Each native install source has its own pinned commit. Historical versions and CATALOG snapshots remain available. Future publications must keep this actual release feed synchronized.

`SOURCES.json` records original CC0 provenance and hashes. Shared packaging and CI verify every current registry release has its canonical PNG, embedded URI and matching identity metadata, preventing later business updates from restoring an old icon. The official 8 MiB module limit is checked; the center binds styling once and is 5,993,744 bytes. Maintenance guidance is included in AGENTS.md and docs/IDENTITY_ICONS.md.

Validation at e20737c4cdbdd5b35210d3b2645a3035a3abb0d3: complete `npm run ci` passed 115 Node tests, 69 service tests, reproducible builds and all package/ZIP/SHA checks. Registration tests compare manifest grants, exports, inject lists, native contribution IDs/placement and tool schemas against every exact business baseline. Official Buzz 1.0.2 PageIcon rendered 102 light/dark size samples; all original 500px image hashes and transparency match. Catalog content/card geometry and identities passed at 1440/768/390px.

The owner approved all 17 native update cards. Final installed source commits match all 17 recommended plugin IDs; all are enabled and active, with the final Mobile Design error readback null. A read-only native window check saw the updated sidebar. No business messages, task writes, host build or client upgrade. Other members and physical iPad/Android/iOS business behavior have not been accepted. Source branch and release feed are published; this draft PR is not merged.

author: miaopantao
body:

body:

The plugin keeps the same ID and original artifact collection, stores the plan in a separate preference, and ships empty. Team plans, source excerpts and private media are imported privately and are not in the repository. The prior report and brand-library versions remain available.

Validation: full `npm run ci` (17 tests and all distribution/checksum checks); Ego browser verified date shifting, filters, save/reopen without changing the sample library, budget calculations, unknown versus zero, plan import, and desktop/390px layouts. Studio's native report was separately restored to 5 templates and 26 screens and exported for exact comparison. New plugin installation and native post-upgrade verification remain subject to the owner's review; no host upgrade or spending was performed.

body:
将成果报告的固定10个位置改为按品牌用途排序、可持续新增的模板库。四类依次为产品质感展示、产品使用场景、品牌故事／工艺、上新促销，原10个保留为阶段目标；生日等内容独立保留。

新增本机模板保存、分类调整和JSON迁移/备份。公开包继续留空，原有私人样片与手机截图不进入仓库；新增项明确标为候选，真实经营数据仍留空。旧报告目录与ZIP保留为历史版本，目录指向新的独立分发提交。

验证：完整 `npm run ci` 通过（13项测试、所有分发包和SHA、空态渲染）。EgoLite以React和官方v1.0.1存储契约替身验证原5项/11屏导入、11项扩展、重开保存、调整分类后重复导入、导出、Blob视频播放、手机预览键盘及390px深浅色。

兼容基线：官方Buzz v1.0.1，本机1.0.1/1.0.1，API v1。实际宿主安装及Android/iOS尚未验收；旧安装来自社区Git，换源需用户审核移除旧注册，再审核安装。无宿主构建或远端CI声明。
title: 成果报告：品牌分类与可扩展模板库

author: miaopantao
body:
插件中心此前只有 GitHub 源码和 ZIP 入口，成员需要自行寻找版本。本次增加原生 `opcb.plugin-center`：搜索和分类浏览 13 类业务插件，查看依赖和本机安装状态，并通过 Buzz 宿主审核安装或更新。

目录先读取 main 的完整 head，再按该 head 读取 REGISTRY.json。每项安装源固定独立分发分支和提交，避免大型仓库的目录发现遗漏。号池 1.3 默认收在历史版本中；同 ID 已安装不代表此版本相同。目录刷新失败保留旧目录并暂停安装；旧宿主缺少能力时明确提示，不静默安装。

插件仅申请 api.github.com 网络访问，不读取 Cookie、令牌或本机配置。安装仍由使用者在宿主中最终确认。

验证：本地完整 `npm run ci` 通过，含 9 项 Node 测试、全部 JS/manifest、Python 桥接语法、所有 ZIP 与 SHA256，以及既有空白模板检查。EGO 使用真实 React 和宿主替身验证搜索、分类、状态、历史版本、精确来源、审核取消、刷新失败恢复、旧宿主降级、键盘与深浅色/480px布局；不是实际 Buzz 安装验收。

潘涛在本频道明确本仓库采用本机构建（消息 512679bf852a6dbd5f2b2dc897a36463cccfb25f0f5d8a01dcdab9f6a2953e8b）。本次按该方式完成本机打包与完整验证，GitHub Actions 改为仅手动入口，旧排队 run 已取消，不再等待 Runner 接入；未将本机验证记录成远端 CI 成功。该调整仅限本仓库。
title: 新增 Buzz 原生 OPCB 插件中心
